name: basic try catch
code: <?php try { throw new Exception("boom"); } catch (Exception $e) { echo "caught ", $e->getMessage(); } echo " after";

name: code and default values
code: <?php try { throw new Exception("m", 42); } catch (Exception $e) { var_dump($e->getMessage(), $e->getCode()); } $d = new Exception(); var_dump($d->getMessage(), $d->getCode(), $d->getPrevious());

name: statements after throw are skipped
code: <?php try { echo "a"; throw new Exception("x"); echo "b"; } catch (Exception $e) { echo "c"; } echo "d";

name: no exception skips catch
code: <?php try { echo "a"; } catch (Exception $e) { echo "b"; } echo "c";

name: finally always runs
code: <?php try { echo "a"; } finally { echo "f"; } try { throw new Exception("x"); } catch (Exception $e) { echo "c"; } finally { echo "g"; }

name: finally with return in try
code: <?php function f() { try { return "try"; } finally { echo "finally "; } } echo f();

name: finally return overrides try return
code: <?php function f() { try { return "try"; } finally { return "finally"; } } echo f();

name: finally return swallows exception
code: <?php function f() { try { throw new Exception("lost"); } finally { return "kept"; } } echo f();

name: finally runs when exception propagates
code: <?php function f() { try { throw new Exception("up"); } finally { echo "cleanup "; } } try { f(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }

name: finally with break and continue in loops
code: <?php for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) { try { if ($i == 1) { continue; } if ($i == 2) { break; } echo "body$i "; } finally { echo "fin$i "; } } echo "end";

name: catch order first match wins
code: <?php try { throw new InvalidArgumentException("x"); } catch (RuntimeException $e) { echo "runtime"; } catch (LogicException $e) { echo "logic"; } catch (Exception $e) { echo "exception"; }

name: multi catch
code: <?php foreach ([1, 2, 3] as $n) { try { if ($n == 1) { throw new TypeError("t"); } if ($n == 2) { throw new ValueError("v"); } throw new RuntimeException("r"); } catch (TypeError | ValueError $e) { echo get_class($e), " "; } catch (Exception $e) { echo "other "; } }

name: catch without variable
code: <?php try { throw new Exception("x"); } catch (Exception) { echo "caught without variable"; }

name: catch Throwable catches Error and Exception
code: <?php foreach ([new Exception("e"), new Error("r"), new TypeError("t")] as $x) { try { throw $x; } catch (Throwable $t) { echo get_class($t), ":", $t->getMessage(), " "; } }

name: Error is not an Exception
code: <?php try { try { throw new Error("err"); } catch (Exception $e) { echo "wrong"; } } catch (Error $e) { echo "right ", $e->getMessage(); }

name: builtin hierarchy instanceof
code: <?php $e = new DivisionByZeroError("d"); var_dump($e instanceof ArithmeticError, $e instanceof Error, $e instanceof Throwable, $e instanceof Exception); $o = new OutOfBoundsException("o"); var_dump($o instanceof RuntimeException, $o instanceof LogicException, $o instanceof Exception);
expected:
bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(false)
bool(true)
bool(false)
bool(true)

name: spl exception parents
code: <?php foreach ([new BadMethodCallException(), new DomainException(), new LengthException(), new OutOfRangeException(), new OverflowException(), new RangeException(), new UnderflowException(), new UnexpectedValueException(), new ArgumentCountError(), new JsonException()] as $e) { echo get_class($e), ":", $e instanceof LogicException ? "L" : "-", $e instanceof RuntimeException ? "R" : "-", $e instanceof Error ? "E" : "-", " "; }

name: user exception class
code: <?php class MyEx extends Exception {} try { throw new MyEx("mine", 3); } catch (MyEx $e) { echo get_class($e), "|", $e->getMessage(), "|", $e->getCode(), "|", $e instanceof Exception ? "y" : "n"; }

name: user exception with constructor and extra data
code: <?php class HttpError extends RuntimeException { public $status; public function __construct($status, $message) { parent::__construct($message, $status); $this->status = $status; } public function describe() { return $this->status . " " . $this->getMessage(); } } try { throw new HttpError(404, "Not Found"); } catch (HttpError $e) { echo $e->describe(), "|", $e->getCode(); }

name: user exception overriding message property
code: <?php class Fixed extends Exception { protected $message = "fixed message"; protected $code = 9; } try { throw new Fixed(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|", $e->getCode(); }

name: user exception without parent constructor call
code: <?php class Bare extends Exception { public function __construct() {} } try { throw new Bare(); } catch (Exception $e) { var_dump($e->getMessage(), $e->getCode(), $e->getLine()); }

name: exception from nested function calls
code: <?php function a() { b(); echo "unreached"; } function b() { c(); } function c() { throw new LogicException("deep"); } try { a(); } catch (LogicException $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }

name: exception from method
code: <?php class Svc { public function run($x) { if ($x < 0) { throw new InvalidArgumentException("negative: " . $x); } return $x * 2; } } $s = new Svc(); try { echo $s->run(2), " "; echo $s->run(-1); } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }

name: exception from static method and closure
code: <?php class U { public static function fail() { throw new DomainException("static"); } } $f = function() { throw new RangeException("closure"); }; try { U::fail(); } catch (DomainException $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), " "; } try { $f(); } catch (RangeException $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }

name: rethrow same exception
code: <?php try { try { throw new Exception("inner"); } catch (Exception $e) { echo "first "; throw $e; } } catch (Exception $e) { echo "second ", $e->getMessage(); }

name: exception chaining with previous
code: <?php try { try { throw new InvalidArgumentException("low", 1); } catch (Exception $e) { throw new RuntimeException("high", 2, $e); } } catch (RuntimeException $e) { $p = $e->getPrevious(); echo $e->getMessage(), "<-", $p->getMessage(), "|", get_class($p), "|", $p->getCode(); var_dump($p->getPrevious()); }

name: throw in catch reaches outer finally
code: <?php try { try { throw new Exception("a"); } catch (Exception $e) { throw new Exception("b"); } finally { echo "inner-finally "; } } catch (Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }

name: exception thrown in finally replaces
code: <?php try { try { throw new Exception("first"); } finally { throw new Exception("second"); } } catch (Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|", $e->getPrevious() === null ? "no-prev" : $e->getPrevious()->getMessage(); }

name: nested try in loop continues
code: <?php $ok = 0; $bad = 0; foreach ([1, 0, 2, 0, 5] as $d) { try { $r = intdiv(10, $d); $ok++; } catch (DivisionByZeroError $e) { $bad++; } } echo $ok, "/", $bad;

name: throw as expression
code: <?php $v = null; try { $x = $v ?? throw new Exception("null value"); } catch (Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|"; } $f = fn($n) => $n > 0 ? $n : throw new RangeException("not positive"); try { echo $f(3), "|"; echo $f(0); } catch (RangeException $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }
